about_blocks.text: Windsor Life Centre is a residential, faith-based treatment Centre for women recovering from drug and alcohol addictions. The Centre is located in Windsor, Ontario and offers specialized care to women who require a safe and supportive environment for recovery.

about_blocks.text: At Windsor Life Centre, we specialize in 12 Step Programs and Substance Abuse Treatment. Our team of experienced professionals is dedicated to providing personalized care to each of our patients. Our goal is to equip our patients with the necessary tools and support to achieve lasting recovery.

about_blocks.text: Windsor Life Centre is a residential, faith-based treatment center designed to help women struggling with drug and alcohol addictions. It is a safe and supportive environment where residents can recover with the guidance of caring professionals. The center offers programs specifically for adults and young adults, with a treatment duration of 180-365 days. With a maximum capacity of 20 beds, Windsor Life Centre maintains a small community feel where residents can receive personalized and individualized treatment.

about_blocks.text: One of the standout features of Windsor Life Centre is its faith-based approach. The center encourages residents to re-establish a relationship with God and develop their spirituality as part of the recovery process. The center’s emphasis on faith makes it a unique and potentially beneficial option for those seeking a more holistic approach to addiction treatment. Additionally, as a smoke-free facility, Windsor Life Centre is committed to promoting a healthy and clean living environment. Overall, Windsor Life Centre is an ideal choice for women who are seeking a supportive, faith-based approach to addiction recovery.
